info.name: Chronos
info.summary: Time tracking tied to your Nextcloud Tasks lists
info.description:
Chronos turns your Nextcloud Tasks lists into time-tracked projects.
- Check in and check out with a live timer - Optionally assign each session to any of your Tasks lists - Pause and resume sessions without losing context - Add an optional note describing what you are working on - Weekly overview with a per-day bar chart and per-project breakdown - Log of recent sessions with durations, notes and project color - Dashboard widget with full controls (start, pause, stop) from the Nextcloud home - Delete sessions from the log when you need to clean up
Built natively on Nextcloud Tasks — no separate project data, no duplicate lists. If you already organise your work in Tasks lists, Chronos simply adds the time layer on top.
